provider: Senatsverwaltung für Mobilität, Verkehr, Klimaschutz und Umwelt Berlin (Grünflächeninformationssystem); WFS by Senatsverwaltung für Stadtentwicklung, Bauen und Wohnen Berlin
attribution: Geoportal Berlin / Grünanlagenbestand Berlin (einschließlich der öffentlichen Spielplätze), WFS gruenanlagen, Datenlizenz Deutschland – Zero – Version 2.0; transformed to EPSG:4326.

limitations: Official inventory of dedicated public green spaces (objartname 'Grünanlage') and public playgrounds ('Spielplatz') maintained by the Berlin districts; it does not include private, courtyard, school, cemetery, allotment or forest areas unless they are part of the inventory. Dataset revision 2026-04-09 (CSW metadata); source access, CRS, paging and field mapping checked 2026-10-18.
Polygons are the source geometry reprojected EPSG:25833 -> EPSG:4326. display_point is a derived marker (representative point computed in EPSG:25833), not an entrance or access point.

Green-space and playground polygons are separate inventory objects (playgrounds are mostly adjacent to, not inside, green-space polygons). adjacent_record_ids links them; do not add playground area to green-space area as one figure without checking overlaps.

area_code is the provider-supplied plannr (one LOR Planungsraum per feature); features crossing PLR boundaries are still assigned to one code. Codes are reported against the pinned LOR snapshot, never reassigned.

katasterfl (cadastral area) and nettospfl (net play area) values of 0 are treated as missing, not as zero area; geometry_area_m2 is computed from the polygon in EPSG:25833 and may differ from the cadastral figure.
Proximity from this dataset is straight-line distance in EPSG:25833 to the polygon edge; it is not walking distance or walking time and ignores entrances, fences and barriers.
Official records are not matched or deduplicated against OSM leisure features; never add counts from both sources for the same area.
